title: Ukrainian Pastry Puffs
description: Delicate pastry puffs filled with a flaky, savory robust filling, perfect for an Italian-inspired appetizer.
instructions: Roll out the puff pastry to a thickness of about 1/8 inch (3 mm).
Cut out small squares of pastry, about 3 inches (7.5 cm) per side.
In a small bowl, mix together the chopped sausage, onion, and flaky sea salt.
Place a small spoonful of the sausage mixture onto the center of each pastry square.
Fold the pastry squares in half to form triangles, pressing the edges to seal.
Place the pastry puffs onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Dot the tops of the pastry puffs with butter.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
Optional: Sprinkle with chopped Ukrainian sausage before baking.
